title: Guide DOM replays with cursor and focus motion

fields.outcome: Walkthrough viewers can clearly follow user actions through an enlarged cursor, click emphasis, and smooth focus zoom synchronized with replay playback.
fields.scope: Add optional cursor scaling and click pulse plus click-driven replay zoom with configurable scale, transition, and hold timing. Reset focus on pause, restart, completion, and viewport changes, and honor reduced-motion preferences. Exclude semantic AI importance detection and author-marked non-click focus steps in this first slice.
fields.acceptance: A caller can enlarge the replay cursor and enable click focus; each replayed click smoothly focuses around its recorded coordinates and returns to the full view, while pause, restart, completion, and reduced-motion behavior remain predictable.
fields.decisions: Drive focus from rrweb EventCast click events so no captured application code runs. Transform the replay wrapper around recorded click coordinates, clamp visual scale to a conservative range, and suppress transitions when reduced motion is requested.
fields.verification: Add generated player tests for normalized cursor and focus settings, use Playwright to observe scale changes during a deterministic replay, verify reset states and reduced motion, inspect the DealDesk example, and run the full package and frozen AgentHouse checks.
fields.dependencies: Uses the ST-11 presentation shell and existing rrweb playback events.
fields.risks: Zoom can induce motion discomfort, obscure context, or leave a transformed player after controls are used. Keep it opt-in, provide conservative bounds, honor reduced motion, and reset on all lifecycle transitions.
fields.audience: Viewers of product walkthroughs and the teams producing them.
fields.changes: Implemented in commit 09c550b785a8ac7af2dcdb57887aaf5cd12bde48: DOM profiles can enlarge the rrweb cursor, retain or suppress click pulse, and apply click-synchronized focus zoom with bounded scale and timing. Focus resets on pause, restart, completion, resize, and reduced-motion changes.
fields.evidence: A real-browser test observed the configured 1.25 focus scale during a replayed click and verified reset on pause, responsive fitting, and successful composed WebM output. The live DealDesk example used a 1.8 cursor and 1.3 click focus and was visually inspected during focus and at completion. The full package suite passed 84 tests and frozen Agenthouse evaluation for the exact build satisfied all seven configured checks.

criteria.expectation: Callers can opt into a visibly larger cursor without changing captured application layout.
Replayed clicks can show an optional pulse distinct from ordinary cursor movement.
Click focus smoothly zooms around recorded click coordinates and automatically returns to the full view.
Pause, restart, completion, and viewport changes restore an unzoomed stable player.
Reduced-motion preference disables animated zoom transitions while preserving replay usability.
Cursor and focus enhancements are disabled when omitted and existing replay behavior remains unchanged.
